title: A demo that previewed your desktop

probes.question: Who gave the 1968 live demonstration of the oN-Line System?
True or false: the demonstration showed the computer mouse.

image.alt: Smiling portrait of Douglas Engelbart, an elderly man with white hair, wearing a tweed jacket and blue shirt.
image.credit: Alex Handy from Oakland, Nmibia / Wikimedia Commons

body.claim: On December 9, 1968, Douglas Engelbart gave a 90-minute live demonstration in San Francisco of a system called the oN-Line System, or NLS.
body.why: It demonstrated windows, hypertext, graphics, video conferencing, the computer mouse and more. It was the first to publicly demonstrate all of these elements in a single system. Approximately 1,000 computer professionals were in attendance.
